target_customer: Battery R&D teams at cell makers, materials developers and automotive and aviation companies
problem: Battery companies spend heavily on physical experiments. Simulation could replace many of them but is hard to build and run, so Ionworks offers model fitting and cloud simulation on top of PyBaMM.
business_model: B2B software subscription with cloud, private cloud and air-gapped deployment

founders.name: Valentin Sulzer
education: Engineering research at University of Michigan and Carnegie Mellon (4 years)
founders.background_notes: Created the open-source PyBaMM package per the YC page.

founders.name: Rob Timms
founders.background_notes: Core developer of PyBaMM per the YC page.

competitors.name: About:Energy
competitors.what: UK battery modeling and testing software spinout

technical_complexity.rationale: Physics-based electrochemical model fitting and large scale cloud simulation need deep domain expertise; the team's PyBaMM background addresses it.

defensibility.rationale: Authors of the standard open-source engine have credibility and data pipelines from cyclers create integration lock-in, but the engine itself is open source and incumbents like Ansys and COMSOL exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbent simulation vendors are named as comparisons on Ionworks' own 2026 pages; no copying or acquisition found.

market_need_then: The YC page says battery companies spend tens of millions per year on experiments. The Faraday Institution supported the founder with a 2023 entrepreneurial fellowship per a search summary.

branding.domain_note: Uses ionworks.com; a trademark application for IONWORKS was filed 2024-04-30 by Ionworks Technologies Inc per a search summary.

identity.visual_style: technical software site with case studies

branding.brand_signature: Built by the creators and maintainers of PyBaMM
branding.community_and_virality: Brand leans on the PyBaMM open-source community; not measured.

brand_strength.rationale: Credibility comes from PyBaMM, not the Ionworks name itself; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Ionworks is active with named battery customers and partners including NOVONIX and Iontra. Founders who authored PyBaMM give unusual domain fit. Funding is not publicly confirmed, so its trajectory depends on converting open-source credibility into paid contracts against large simulation vendors.
notes: Aggregators (Bouncewatch, VCBacked) report a 500K pre-seed in September 2024 led by YC and Dealroom lists 125K; none confirmed by a primary source, so no round recorded. Rob Timms is called CTO on the YC page. Tom Tranter appears in the launch post but is not recorded as a founder. Competitor entry comes from a search summary, page not opened.
